description_en: Purchases one or more storage capacity units (SCUs)
description_zh: 本接口用于购买一个或多个存储容量单位包SCU（Storage Capacity Unit）
name: PurchaseStorageCapacityUnit

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the SCU. After you specify a region, the SCU can only offset pay-as-you-go bills for cloud disks in that region. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent list of Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh: SCU所属的地域ID。确定地域后，SCU只能抵扣该地域下云盘的按量付费账单。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the SCU. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: SCU的名称，长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The capacity of the SCU. Unit: GiB. Valid values: 20, 40, 100, 200, 500, 1024, 2048, 5210, 10240, 20480, and 52100
parameters.name: capacity

parameters.help_en: The description of the SCU. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: SCU的描述信息，长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The effective period of the SCU. The effective period cannot be more than 180 days after the creation time. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHHZ format. The time must be in UTC.

Default value: null, which indicates that the SCU takes effect immediately after it is created
parameters.help_zh:
SCU的生效时间。生效时间不能超过创建时间开始的180天。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHHZ。

默认值：无，表示从创建时间开始生效
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The validity period of the SCU. Valid values:

When PeriodUnit is set to Month, valid values of Period are 1, 2, 3, and 6.
When PeriodUnit is set to Year, valid values of Period are 1, 3, and 5.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
SCU的有效期时长。取值范围：

当PeriodUnit=Month时，Period参数的有效取值为1、2、3、6。
当PeriodUnit=Year时，Period参数的有效取值为1、3、5。

默认值：1
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the validity period of the SCU. Valid values:

Month: month.
Year: year.

Default value: Month
parameters.help_zh:
SCU的有效期时长单位。取值范围：

Month：月。
Year：年。

默认值：Month
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en: The source of the request. The default value is OpenAPI. You do not need to manually set this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 用于备注请求来源，默认值为OpenAPI，无需手动设置
parameters.name: from_app

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。`ClientToken`只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of SCUs to purchase. Valid values: 1 to 20.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
购买的SCU的数量。取值范围：1~20。

默认值：1
parameters.name: amount

fields.help_en: The tag key of the SCU. If you specify this parameter, the tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: SCU的标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the SCU. If you specify this parameter, the tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: SCU的标签值。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the storage capacity unit (SCU) belongs. You can specify only a resource group ID to which you have permissions
parameters.help_zh: 存储容量单位包所在的资源组ID。您只能传入已有权限的资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id
